actual_family.overlap_rule: both boundaries and the nonboundary chart partition/overlap one full gate; their capacities are not additive

primitive_carriers.definition: radical of the phase numerator gcd after removing every prime <=4h+3
primitive_carriers.exact_zero_strata: Z0={h:X_h=Y_h=0 in Q}, Z1={h:U_h=V_h=0 in Q} are kept separately
primitive_carriers.xy_implication: outside Z0, B_xy implies p divides mathfrak_G0(h)
primitive_carriers.uv_implication: outside Z1, B_uv implies p divides mathfrak_G1(h)
primitive_carriers.target_line_equivalence: the paired linear resultants have exactly the same >4h+3 prime support as the Item364 phase carrier

whipple_rectangle.unit_property: both crossed normalized values are p-units for every actual p>=4h+9
whipple_rectangle.contiguity_gap: A_h-A_s=B_h-B_s=(10h+3)/6 is nonintegral on every potentially prime ray
whipple_rectangle.consequence: classical integer-contiguous transfer cannot reach either actual diagonal entry from its Whipple companion

rank_theorems.scope: bounded coefficient-state or matched-value interpolation uniform in the numerator parameter; target-specific identities at A_s,A_h remain open

method_class_closure.ordinary_resultant_height: O(h^2 log(h+2)); it is weaker than imposing the tied linear target first
method_class_closure.target_line_height: O(h log(h+2)) pointwise, but O(M^2 log M) after direct fixed-M summation
method_class_closure.saturated_comparison: Sat_>4h+3((18h)!/(4h)!) retains every actual p on M/12<=h<=M/3
method_class_closure.closed: natural crossed Whipple completion, classical integer contiguity, bounded parameter-uniform state, ordinary resultant height, and generic saturated recurrence-height-divisor-sieve reasoning
method_class_closure.not_closed: target-specific large-prime factors, selector-aware large sieve, average gcd, or a new identity specialized to the actual two moving parameters

remaining_target.weighted_goal: sum_h log(p_h)*(1_(h in Z0 union Z1)+1_(outside exact-zero strata)*1_(p_h divides mathfrak_G0(h)mathfrak_G1(h)))=o(M)
remaining_target.consequence_if_proved: both boundary charts become zero rate, but the nonboundary full-gate chart remains
